title: Floors
description: Every storey of your home, drawn to scale, with its rooms.

empty.title: Draw your first floor
empty.description: Start with the ground floor: give it a size, then trace its rooms on a grid or over a picture of your plan.
empty.member: No floors have been drawn yet. An admin can add them.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: The floor is deleted. This can't be undone. | The floor and its room are deleted. This can't be undone. | The floor and its {n} rooms are deleted. This can't be undone.

form.createDescription: Name it and give it a size. You can change both later.
form.name: Name
form.levelHelp: 0 is the ground floor, 1 the floor above it, -1 a basement.
form.sizeHelp: The outside size of the floor; rooms are drawn inside it.

view.title: Floor plan
view.noRooms: An admin can draw the rooms of this floor.
view.noRoomsAdmin: Open the editor to draw the rooms of this floor.
view.noRoomsShort: No rooms on this floor yet.

editor.title: Edit floor plan
editor.heading: Editing {name}
editor.nothingToSave: Nothing to save: the plan is as you left it.
editor.fixProblems: Some rooms need your attention before saving.
editor.problems: Fix this before saving | Fix this before saving | Fix these {count} problems before saving

hints.select: Click a room to select it and drag to move it. Drag a corner to reshape it, or a wall's middle dot to add one.
hints.selectShort: Tap a room to select it.
hints.draw: Click to place corners; finish on the first corner or with Enter. Or drag to draw a rectangle. Alt places freely.
hints.drawShort: Tap to place corners; tap the first corner to finish.
hints.drawNextShort: {count} corners placed. Tap the first corner to finish; Undo takes one back.
hints.drawNext: {count} corners placed. Finish on the first corner or with Enter; Backspace takes one back, Esc cancels.
hints.calibrate: Click a point on the image whose distance to another point you know.
hints.background: Drag to move the image under the plan.
hints.noBackground: Upload a plan image in the Background panel first.

empty.title: Draw your first room
empty.description: Pick Draw room and click its corners, or drag a rectangle. Rooms snap to the grid and to each other.

rooms.empty: Draw the rooms of this floor; each gets a name, a color and an icon.

room.title: Room
room.name: Name
room.minCorners: A room needs at least 3 corners.

floor.gridHelp: Corners snap to this grid. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely.

background.title: Background image
background.description: Trace your rooms over a scan or a photo of the floor plan. It shows faintly under the rooms.
background.formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB.
background.calibrateHelp: Click two points whose real distance you know, such as the ends of a wall.

calibration.title: How far apart are they?
calibration.description: The two points are {measured} apart on the plan now. Enter their real distance and the image is scaled to match.
calibration.invalid: Enter a distance greater than zero.
calibration.outOfRange: That makes the image too large or too small. Check the distance and the unit.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this floor
conflict.description: This floor was saved by someone else while you were editing. Reload it to see their version; your unsaved changes will be lost.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: Your changes to this floor plan haven't been saved and will be lost.
